plan.governed_by: 008 ADR-001 D2: structure only; no attempts, events or pane ids

tasks.title: test: record the deterministic baseline before Phase 0
tasks.criteria: At the branch point, before any source change: make dst, then make eval_matrix, one at a time. evidence/baseline-<sha>/ holds README.md (what ran, where, how long), run_baseline.sh, the FAILED target names from make dst, MATRIX.tsv and a compare script, on the pattern of 011's baseline-59d5cbb9. The script reproduces the directory.
tasks.note: Ruling 5. Targets already failing at the base are recorded as such, not fixed. One task, one commit.

tasks.title: impl: the disclosure types, the two ProcessError mappings, and every construction site
tasks.criteria: types.ail has the two-arm disclosure sum and the fault record; ToolErrorResult carries it as a required field, BashExecResult and RunTestsResult as an Option that is None on the Ok arm. One home holds the key, values, kinds and two sentences (C3). Two pure mappings over ProcessError, each an exhaustive match with no wildcard and one inline test row per arm, give kind and disclosure per ADR D2 as ruled (NotFound, NotAllowed none; the other five unknown). Every construction site in tool_runtime.ail states the value in the plan's W0.2 table. make check_core and make test_coverage pass.
tasks.note: Re-ground first, and check whether #234/#209 have landed: any ToolErrorResult they add must state a fault. One commit, because a required field does not compile partially.

tasks.title: impl: tool_result_item_to_json emits fault
tasks.criteria: BashExecResult and RunTestsResult emit fault when Some, after exit_code and before stdout and stderr; ToolErrorResult always emits it after error. The Ok arm's JSON is byte-identical to before. New inline tests in tool_dispatch_adapter.ail: a faulted BashExecResult with key order asserted, a ToolErrorResult, and an Ok result byte-equal to its pre-W0 rendering. make check_core, make test_coverage and make world_state pass.
tasks.note: The file has no tests today. One task, one commit.

tasks.title: impl: the BashExec description says what happens past the cap
tasks.criteria: tool_catalog.ail:54 carries the plan's W0.4 wording, or the operator's replacement; no other copy of the old sentence exists outside 037's recorded evidence. Confirmed in writing that the description is not part of system_prefix_digest. make check_core passes.
tasks.note: timeout_secs stays in the schema, unread, until W0b. One task, one commit.

tasks.title: test: live witness rows through run_process_result
tasks.criteria: A new entry beside exit_code_witness in scripts/dst/world_state_probe.ail, run with full caps by make world_state, holds rows a-h of the plan's W0.5 table and reads the rendered message. Rows a and b are the ADR's one unknown and one none arm; c is the no-fault survival row. Rows e and f report not evaluated, never passed, when run as root. make world_state is green.
tasks.note: Precedent: exit_code_witness (world_state_probe.ail:1128-1179), the live-arm witness ports.ail:1741-1743 names. One task, one commit.

tasks.title: test: Phase 0 mutation run
tasks.criteria: mutants.tsv, the script and the commit cover m01-m15 of the plan's W0.6 table, each with its expected test named before the run; a kill is that test failing, nothing else. Every row is a kill, or a survivor with a new test or a sentence why no input can tell the versions apart. The no-wildcard property is recorded as a survivor by construction. Tree clean afterwards.
tasks.note: Meta-decision: mutate each stated rule once and see its test fail.

tasks.title: gate: baseline after, comparison, records
tasks.criteria: At the PR head, make dst then make eval_matrix, compared row by row with W0.1. The only differing rows are make world_state's new rows and make test_coverage's new tests; any other difference is recorded with its cause. make compose_live_exec, make verify_native_path_guard and bun run test (src/tui) pass. The ADR status line names the PR; the plan's status moves on.
tasks.note: Green is a difference (ruling 5). The no-change expectation for eval_matrix rests on journals replaying recorded tool content verbatim (world.ail:88-89); this run tests it.

tasks.title: test: probe the deadline wrapper through run_process_result
tasks.criteria: evidence/wrapper_probe.sh and a results file answer, through run_process_result and the rendered message: how a wrapper deadline is told from a command's own exit 124; what happens where GNU timeout is absent (stock macOS); the direct-exec arm; case A under a wrapper; and what the wrapper adds under AILANG >=0.54.14.
tasks.note: NOTE §6.3's open points and ADR D6.

tasks.title: question: does Phase 0b go ahead, re-scoped, or not at all?
tasks.criteria: The operator answers on W0b.1's results, the state of sunholo-data/ailang#1878, and whether the pin has moved to >=0.54.14. Withdrawing cancels W0b.3 and W0b.4.
tasks.note: Partial output upstream (#1878) would remove the wrapper's main reason.

tasks.title: impl: the deadline wrapper in run_process_result
tasks.criteria: As W0b.2 decides. Planned: both arms wrapped; deadline is timeout_secs clamped below the wall, otherwise just under the wall; a wrapper deadline renders kind deadline, effects unknown, with captured output; no timeout binary means no wrapper; the dropped req.args on the bash -lc arm fixed or shown not to be a defect. make check_core, make world_state pass.
tasks.note: Surface: tool_runtime.ail:974-1025, tool_catalog.ail.

tasks.title: gate: wrapper mutants, baseline pass, records
tasks.criteria: Mutants w1-w4 of the plan's W0b.4 table killed by their named witness rows; make dst and make eval_matrix compared with W0's head, differences explained; records updated.
tasks.note: One worktree, one PR for W0b.

tasks.title: docs: re-ground Phase 1 and settle the version numbers
tasks.criteria: Every Phase 1 anchor re-read at the branch point, moves recorded. The next free program schema version is chosen against 031 PLAN-001 P2.1's state; if W1 takes /5, a note is added to 031's plan. fault-catalogue, invariant-set and profile versions checked the same way.
tasks.note: Phase 1 depends on W0 for C3's one home, not on W0b.

tasks.title: impl: ScriptedTool gains applied and a dispatch stage; next program schema version
tasks.criteria: ScriptedTool has applied and a before/after stage. The program schema is at the next version; older versions decode to after dispatch, not applied, by a stated presence rule or by threading the version into decode_tool_outcome. A frozen fixture of the new version exists. Validation rejects applied on a before-dispatch fault. make check_core and the program pin test pass.
tasks.note: Precedent ba272abc (/1 to /2, 21 files). S30 and S32 govern the default.

tasks.title: impl: the world effect log, and ToolFailed's stage
tasks.criteria: WorldState has an append-only effect log of {call_id, effect_key}; only world_tool's scripted arm appends, and only when applied. scripted_tool_outcome reads neither applied nor the log. ToolFailed carries the dispatch stage; ToolDeadlineExceeded and ToolCorrelationMismatch are unchanged. make check_core and make world_state pass.
tasks.note: ADR D4: no carrier for applied in ToolOutcome.

tasks.title: impl: the typed renderer, denials and undecodable arguments emit fault; the anchor cascade
tasks.criteria: tool_fault_message emits fault (ToolFailed before dispatch none, after unknown; deadline and mismatch unknown); denial_message and undecodable_arguments_message emit none. Anchors at tool_phase.ail:388/389/484 and the attribution rows are re-baselined; the new table_content_hash is in all four profiles with dated version bumps. The denial byte test is updated. The journal A2 remedy for pre-W1 messages is stated and make eval_matrix rows are explained. make anchors, attribution_table, test_coverage, fault_catalogue pass.
tasks.note: Choices C1 and C2. Precedent for a profile bump: 072bb05a.

tasks.title: impl: catalogue /3 — a visibility field and two world-only rows
tasks.criteria: Every row carries wire or world-only-with-twin. tool_effect_applied_then_failed and tool_effect_applied_then_deadline copy their twins' constructor and branch. validate_catalogue rejects a missing, world-only or mismatched twin. fault-catalogue/3, count 13, profile_definition_dst.ail:207 updated. observed_classes reads the effect log for world-only rows. A guard in a bank-running target finds no world-only id in any projected tool message. make fault_catalogue passes.
tasks.note: ADR D4. corpus_pr is expected red here until W1.6 re-derives the bank.

tasks.title: impl: the generator draws applied; generator_version, canary and PR bank
tasks.criteria: choose_tool draws applied for after-dispatch Failed and Late under its own salt. generator_version is 2 at every code site and axis K. The canary is re-pinned by hand with the throwaway sweep deleted. fixed_bank() is re-derived and reaches both world-only rows twice; cost constants re-measured if the median moved. make seeded_generator and make corpus_pr pass.
tasks.note: WI-D1: a five-artifact cascade, about 2 h. Budget one make dst per commit.

tasks.title: gate: Phase 1 targets, baseline comparison, records
tasks.criteria: make check_core test_coverage seeded_generator fault_catalogue corpus_pr run_report world_state invariants anchors attribution_table pass; make dst FAILED names equal the base's; every changed make eval_matrix row is explained. ADR and plan status updated.
tasks.note: One worktree, one PR for W1.

tasks.title: impl: rules for properties P1 (EffectDisclosureUnsound) and P3 (ToolCallRedispatched)
tasks.criteria: Both rules under ToolPairing with constructor, family arm, rule id, message, check and sample entry; count 44; invariant-set/3. The oracle reads the world-served log and the effect log against the projected message and never calls tool_outcome_message or its callees. Survival and rejection fixtures in invariants_dst.ail. make invariants and verify_classify_check pass.
tasks.note: Precedent c0f7eb02. The journal eval runs evaluate too.

tasks.title: impl: property P2 as a pair relation with its own runner
tasks.criteria: A pair relation beside discovery_contract_findings, not a family. A runner over bank programs flips one after-dispatch call's applied and requires identical traces, outcomes and served interactions; it has its own make target.
tasks.note: dst_invariants.ail:2189-2195 says why it is not a family.

tasks.title: test: acceptance of properties P1-P3 by mutant
tasks.criteria: Mutants p1a, p1b, p2, p3 of the plan's W2.3 table are each red on the named rule's row; predictions.tsv hashed before the run; the unmutated bank and make corpus_judge's members and controls are clean on both rules.
tasks.note: Pattern: 011 acceptance-ce9cb247.

tasks.title: gate: Phase 2 targets and records
tasks.criteria: make invariants corpus_judge verify_classify_check and the pair runner's target pass; make dst FAILED names equal the base's; every changed make eval_matrix row is explained. ADR and plan status updated.
tasks.note: One worktree, one PR for W2.

tasks.title: impl: report counters for world-only rows, and the duplicate-effect-key metric
tasks.criteria: The run report counts world-only rows from the effect log without counting a twin and its world-only row together; documented_coverage, the_surviving_gaps and the pinned counts are updated. A duplicate-effect-key count is reported, labelled as a generator-side metric in DST.
tasks.note: Runs beside W2 (choice C4).

tasks.title: gate: Phase 3 targets and records
tasks.criteria: make run_report corpus_pr and ailang test src/core/dst_run_report.ail pass; make dst FAILED names equal the base's. Plan status updated.
tasks.note: One worktree, one PR for W3.
